summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a 6-K reporting the successful pricing of €900M 4.500% Senior Notes due 2033 by its indirect subsidiary, Birkenstock Group B.V. Co. KG. The new notes are senior unsecured and guaranteed by certain subsidiaries, listed on The International Stock Exchange, with expected settlement June 19, 2026. Proceeds will redeem €428.5M of existing 5.25% Senior Notes due 2029 at par on June 26, 2026, and may fund discretionary share repurchases or refinance other debt. The redemption is conditional on closing. This is a standard debt refinancing and ordinary-course capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
